fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate (STX), Western Digital (WDC) and other semiconductor and storage stocks rebounded 3-4% as investors reassess the sustainability of datacenter AI investment, with JPMorgan assessing AI selling as excessive.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate rose 77.6% from the start of the year but remains 53.3% below the 52-week high, with uncertainty over supply expansion growing due to Micron's temporary halt of $4.5B Taiwan memory chip plant.
